utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Sam — I’m glad to have you on it. Sunday at the community center will be a lot smoother with your help.

utterances.speaker: Sam

utterances.speaker: Rosa

utterances.speaker: Rey

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sounds good — I’ll double-check the parking and timing for Sunday at the community center, and I’ll let you know if I spot anything missing.

utterances.speaker: Gus

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Uli. How much can you put in, and when can you send it over quietly?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can put in a small amount after lunch on Sunday. Thanks for keeping it quiet, Mina.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik — that should help. I’m just hoping the parking stays clear and no one gets confused about where to go.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep repeating the plan so everyone knows where to park and where to go.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik — that should keep things orderly. I’ll feel better if the route stays clear and people hear the same instructions each time.

utterances.speaker: Leo

utterances.speaker: Nell

utterances.speaker: Quinn

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn. I appreciate you spreading the word, and I’ll be there Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’m glad we got the update out, and I’ll keep nudging folks to come by Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve checked our supplies and noted what we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane

utterances.speaker: Cleo

utterances.text: Mina: Great, thanks, Oren — Sunday at the community center is the plan now. If you can bring the rest by Saturday, that’ll help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Oren

utterances.speaker: Mina

utterances.speaker: Jules

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Mara — I’ll keep you posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Of course — happy to help, and I’ll keep an eye out for any updates too.

utterances.speaker: Opal

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Opal — I might need that later if I forget, but I’ll let you know if I do.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: No problem at all — Sunday at the community center should be easier for everyone. I’ll keep it low-key and pass it along quietly.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess. That means a lot.

utterances.speaker: Tess

utterances.speaker: Leo

utterances.speaker: Kira

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’m mostly hearing it second-hand, so I appreciate you keeping it moving around the block.

utterances.speaker: Vik

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Sam — that’s perfect. Sunday at 4 at the community center is the new plan, and I’ll let the neighbors know you’re helping with donations.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: You got it, Tess — I’ll be there Sunday at 4 at the community center and help with the donations.
